title: 5 Landscapes, One 3,000km Loop — Qinghai-Gansu Finale | China Travel Expert
description:
One drive, about 3,000km, and it feels like five different countries.

The Qinghai-Gansu Grand Loop starts and ends around Xining and circles China's northwest: mirror-flat salt lakes, the rainbow Danxia mountains of Zhangye, high plateau lakes, gobi desert and grassland, threaded together by old Silk Road stops. This is the finale of our loop series — every stop, one route.

🧭 Expert Tip: Drive it clockwise over about 7 days so the light is behind you at the salt lakes and the Danxia at sunset; the reward stop is a hot bowl of Qinghai noodles.

一条环线，约3000公里，五种世界。
